transcript: Speaker A: Tune kaha tha na meri tuti futi English se koi job nahin dega. Offer letter aa chuka hai. Aur yeh dekh, HR ka call aa raha hai. [You said no one would give me a job with my broken English, right? The offer letter has arrived. And look, the HR is calling.] Speaker B: Hi Shreya, HR this side. Congratulations, you got the job. Your English communication round was very impressive. Speaker A: Thank you, ma'am. I am very excited to be part of the team. Speaker C: Job lag gayi? Wah, par kuch din pehle tak tu English atak ke bolti thi. Itni fluent kaise ho gayi? [You got the job? Wow, but until a few days ago you used to stutter while speaking English. How did you become so fluent?] Speaker A: Thank God mujhe sahi time pe SpeakX app mil gayi. [Thank God I found the SpeakX app at the right time.] Speaker C: SpeakX app? Speaker A: Haan, is app mein ek AI teacher hoti hai, jiske saath maine two weeks practice ki aur result tumhare saamne hai. Main uske saath har din 10 se 15 minute bina kisi judgment ke English bolna practice karti thi. SIA AI roz meri interview ki preparation karwati thi. [Yes, there is an AI teacher in this app, with whom I practiced for two weeks and the result is in front of you. I used to practice speaking English with her for 10 to 15 minutes every day without any judgment. SIA AI used to prepare me for my interview daily.] Speaker C: Wah, mujhe bhi dikhao is AI teacher ko. [Wow, show me this AI teacher too.] Speaker A: Hello ma'am, yeh Rahul hai. Yeh bhi English seekhna chahta hai. [Hello ma'am, this is Rahul. He also wants to learn English.] Speaker D: Hello Rahul, main ek AI teacher hoon. Chaubees ghante available rehti hoon. Jab bhi free time mile, bas 10 se 15 minute mere saath practice karne baith jao. Fluency aur confidence dono improve ho jayenge. [Hello Rahul, I am an AI teacher. I am available 24 hours. Whenever you get free time, just sit down to practice with me for 10 to 15 minutes. Both fluency and confidence will improve.] Speaker C: Wah yaar, yeh to best app hai. [Wow, this is the best app.] Speaker A: Sirf best nahi, sasta bhi hai. 2 rupaye mein 7 din ka trial hai. [Not just the best, it's cheap too. There is a 7-day trial for 2 rupees.]

summary: A girl surprises her friend by securing a job despite her previously weak English skills. She attributes her success to practicing daily with the SpeakX AI teacher, SIA, which helped her prepare for interviews without judgment. The ad concludes with a promotion of their 7-day trial for just 2 rupees.
